summary: Extensions should combine calibrated routing with authority tiers, complementary model roles, executable checks, and continual threshold evaluation.

items.text: Use a two-dimensional cascade: model capability may increase with difficulty while tool authority decreases as action risk rises, requiring explicit approval for irreversible steps.
Escalate only the failing role in a planner-executor pair, preserving a validated artifact rather than rerunning the whole task with a larger model.
Feed test, type, policy, security, and contract failures into the routing trigger and treat a clean check as evidence, not merely model confidence.
Run shadow routes on a sample of traffic and publish per-task false-accept, escalation, cost, and latency trends before changing thresholds.
